items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was playing piano, with Lawrence Brown, Johnny Hodges, Al Hall the bass player, Denzil Best the drummer, and Billy Strayhorn was playing congas.

ctx.x: For that group both you and Trummy were doing some writing, was that what you were telling me?
I wasn't doing too much writing. I was

doing more playing then. But I'll tell you during that time where I was doing a lot of writing, on a little small label called HRS, and let's see, who did we have, Harry Carney, Otto Hardwick, Lawrence Brown, Shelley Manne, Billy Taylor the bass player.
